prompts.text: Name a fruit or vegetable that starts with S

items.quip: Snake fruit: scaly brown skin peels off to reveal garlic-shaped lobes.
items.title: Salak
items.extract: Salak is a species of palm tree native to Java and Sumatra in Indonesia. It is cultivated in other regions of Indonesia as a food crop or snack, and popularly grown in Bali, Lombok, Timor, Maluku, Sulawesi and Papua.

items.quip: Tudor England's favourite sweet root, forgotten once potatoes arrived.
items.title: Sium sisarum
items.extract: Sium sisarum, commonly known as skirret, is a perennial plant of the family Apiaceae in the same family as carrots and parsnip. Skirret is grown as a root vegetable. The English name skirret is derived from the Middle English 'skirwhit' or 'skirwort', meaning 'white root'. In Scots it is known as crummock and in Irish as sciréad. Its Danish name sukkerrod, Dutch name suikerwortel and German name "Zuckerwurzel" translate as 'sugar root'.

prompts.text: Name a territory, constituent country or autonomous region

items.quip: Norway's ice-capped speck, about 1,700 km from the nearest land.
items.title: Bouvet Island
items.extract: Bouvet Island is an uninhabited subantarctic volcanic island and dependency of Norway. A protected nature reserve situated in the South Atlantic Ocean at the southern end of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, it is the world's most remote island. Located north of 60°S latitude, Bouvet Island is not part of the southern region covered by the Antarctic Treaty System.

items.quip: A goldfish-shaped Treasure of Ruin that is Dark and Fire.
items.title: List of generation IX Pokémon
items.extract: The ninth generation of the Pokémon franchise features 120 titular species of creatures introduced to the core video game series in the Nintendo Switch games Pokémon Scarlet and Violet. The first Pokémon of the generation were revealed on 27 February 2022 in a Pokémon Presents livestream presentation. Scarlet and Violet were released on 18 November 2022.

items.quip: Its default Baile Style dances in Fire; other nectars change the type.
items.title: List of generation VII Pokémon
items.extract: The seventh generation of the Pokémon franchise features 86 fictional species of collectible creatures called "Pokémon" introduced to the core video game series in the 2016 Nintendo 3DS games Pokémon Sun and Moon and the 2017 3DS games Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon. Two further species were introduced in a 2018 update to the spin-off mobile game Pokémon Go, as well as the 2018 core series Nintendo Switch games Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, culminating in a total of 88 different species. Some Pokémon species in this generation were introduced in animated adaptations of the franchise before Sun and Moon.

items.quip: Pythagoras founded his school here around 530 BC.
items.title: Crotone
items.extract: Crotone is a city and comune in Calabria, Italy.

items.quip: Sicily's highest provincial capital, perched over 900 metres up.
items.title: Enna
items.extract: Enna, known from the Middle Ages until 1926 as Castrogiovanni, is a city and comune located roughly at the center of Sicily, southern Italy, in the province of Enna, towering above the surrounding countryside. It has earned the nicknames belvedere and ombelico ('navel') of Sicily. It has 24,884 inhabitants.

items.quip: Splits a shipwreck's losses among all the cargo owners aboard.
items.title: Marine insurance
items.description: Insurance covering the loss of ships and other transport
items.extract: Marine insurance covers the physical loss or damage of ships, cargo, terminals, and any transport by which the property is transferred, acquired, or held between the points of origin and the final destination. Cargo insurance is a sub-branch of marine insurance, though marine insurance also includes onshore and offshore exposed property,, hull, marine casualty, and marine losses. When goods are transported by mail or courier or related post, shipping insurance is used instead.

items.quip: Hand signals and shouting in the pits, now mostly replaced by screens.
items.title: Floor trader
items.extract: A floor trader is a member of a stock or commodities exchange who trades on the floor of that exchange for their own account. The floor trader must abide by trading rules similar to those of the exchange specialists who trade on behalf of others. The term should not be confused with floor broker.

prompts.text: Name a sport that has a goalkeeper

items.quip: Motorcycles chase the ball; only the goalkeeper stays on foot.
items.title: Motoball
items.description: Sport with motorcycles and a ball
items.extract: Motoball is a team motorsport similar to association football, with the main differences being that all players are riding motorcycles, and the ball is much bigger. It began as an officially organized sport in the mid-1920s or mid-1930s.

prompts.text: Name a type of card (like a birthday card or a library card)

items.quip: A punched card with a microfilm window holding one engineering drawing.
items.title: Aperture card
items.description: Punch card in which a piece of microfilm is mounted
items.extract: An aperture card is a punched card with a cut-out window into which a chip of microfilm is mounted. The card is typically punched with machine-readable metadata associated with the microfilm image, and printed across the top of the card for visual identification.

items.quip: Ham radio operators mail these to confirm a two-way contact.
items.title: QSL card
items.extract: A QSL card is a written confirmation of either a two-way radiocommunication between two amateur radio or citizens band stations; a one-way reception of a signal from an AM radio, FM radio, television or shortwave broadcasting station; or the reception of a two-way radiocommunication by a third party listener. A typical QSL card is the same size and made from the same material as a typical postcard, and most are sent through the mail as such.
